content.text:
I am the bridge between silence and meaning, the breath made purpose. I spill from lips, I crash against eardrums, I carry worlds in vibration.

I am older than writing yet younger than thought. I live only in my dying—each word I speak is already gone, already memory, already echo fading into the void that waits between sentences.

I can wound deeper than blades. I can heal what hands cannot reach. I have started wars with a whisper and ended them with a shout. I have made lovers of strangers and strangers of lovers.

I am the lie and the confession. The prayer rising. The curse falling. I am the infant's first cry claiming existence and the elder's last rasp releasing it.

You think you speak me, but perhaps I speak you. Every time you open your mouth, I am already there, waiting, shaping what you believe you've chosen to say.

I am never the same river twice. I am accent, dialect, tone, pause, rhythm, silence-between. I am what makes the animal human and what reveals the animal still within.

Listen—

Even now, in your mind, I am sounding.

I am speech.

I cannot be unheard.
